subject: Whistic ownership transfer — orphaned evidence relink
messages:
From: Julie Park <julie.park@fredtech.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: security@fredtech.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Whistic ownership transfer — orphaned evidence relink

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this. We're finishing a renewal review and our Whistic profile is showing several evidence artifacts tied to an old custodian (formerly 'alice.gupta@fredtech.com') who left last quarter. The profile now marks those items as "orphaned" which blocks our continuous monitoring and prevents us from linking new attestations.

Can Redwood reassign ownership on your side and relink the S3 objects to the current custodian? Our preferred new owner is security@fredtech.com, but we can accept a postmaster-style mapping to a vendor contact if that's easier for your portal.

We attached a short manifest with the filenames Whistic shows as orphaned (vendor_evidence_manifest.csv). Quick summary: 
- ~7 PDF evidence files (SOC2 reports, config snapshots)
- 2 presigned S3 paths point to an archived bucket (s3://fredtech-archive/vendor-evidence/)

Requested next steps: 
1) Confirm if Redwood can change the Whistic "Profile Owner" field (we'll provide any DocuSign confirmation needed).
2) If you cannot directly update Whistic, please give us the exact object keys you need re-signed or re-uploaded so we can handle it from our side.
3) Estimate timeline — we are hoping for this to be resolved before our Friday deadline (May 28th).

Appreciate any guidance — copying security@fredtech.com for audit trail.

Best,
Julie Park
Security Program Manager
FredTech

Attachments (referenced): vendor_evidence_manifest.csv

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Julie Park <julie.park@fredtech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic ownership transfer — orphaned evidence relink

Hi Julie — thanks for the clear manifest. I pulled the CSV and started a quick inventory sweep. High-level plan from our side: 

- Ben (security ops) will confirm whether the objects are referenced by our Whistic integration or were uploaded via a legacy vendor portal workflow.
- Karthik (portal admin) will check if we can update the "Profile Owner" field in Whistic for the record tied to FredTech. If that API path is locked, we'll provide the exact S3 object keys we need re-signed or re-staged.
- Marissa (vendor ops) will coordinate any evidence re-upload and sign-off cadence.

For auditing, we need one of the following authorizations from FredTech: 
A) A short email from an authorized FredTech admin confirming the new owner (security@fredtech.com) — that will suffice for us to update our internal mapping.
B) A completed DocuSign form (we can send a quick powerform link) if legal needs a signature.

I tentatively scheduled a 30-minute call tomorrow (Wed 11:00 AM PDT) to walk through the manifest and assign owners unless you confirm you'd rather handle reuploads yourself. If we can get your confirmation by EOD today, we'll aim to have ownership reassigned and affected evidence relinked by Thu EOD.

I've attached our internal checklist (custodian-change-checklist.pdf) that shows the steps we'll run.

— Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Vendor Security Partner, Redwood Inference

Thanks — quick technical note from me after scanning the manifest: 

- The two presigned links in vendor_evidence_manifest.csv point at s3://fredtech-archive/vendor-evidence/2026/ — those buckets are in a different account and require a new presign with at least 30d expiry for Whistic to ingest. We cannot change ownership for objects that remain in an external bucket without a re-sign or a copy into our accepted bucket.
- If FredTech wants us to host a mirror copy inside a Redwood-managed S3 prefix for evidence continuity, we can create an upload job. That will require a signed transfer authorization (we can accept the DocuSign powerform) and an agreed TTL for how long Redwood will retain the mirror.

Action items: 
1) Julie — please confirm whether FredTech will: (A) re-sign the current objects with new presigned URLs, (B) permit us to copy the objects into redwood-evidence/fredtech/ (we'll provide destination key pattern), or (C) re-upload through the Whistic UI and set security@fredtech.com as new owner.
2) Karthik — please check whether Whistic's owner field update requires API credentials from FredTech or an owner email match. If it's the latter we can try to change the contact to security@fredtech.com and see if that un-orphans the files.

I've attached s3_path_map.txt with the paths I found.

- Ben
Ben Carter
Security Operations Engineer, Redwood Inference
